dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Hello. I am Lady Ningguang's bodyguard.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Well, that's my title, anyway. In practice, this is a clerical job roughly half the time.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: I was doing various odd jobs for a while, before being roped back in here to my old post once the Jade Chamber was restored.
